description: Minimal persistent memory for Structural Assisted Intelligence. Explanation is provenance. All records are append-only.

observation.status: UNKNOWN | OBSERVED | RELATED | ALIGNED | CONFLICT | DRIFT | STABLE | INSUFFICIENT | UNRESOLVED

relation.provenance: string (operation id that created or last updated it)

operation.operator: OBSERVE | RELATE | ALIGN | DIFFERENTIATE | RESOLVE | STABILIZE | RECALL

log.description: Append-only sequence of operation records. The full path is reconstructed by walking operation → relation → observation links.

invariants: All records are immutable once written.
No observation exists without an OBSERVE operation.
No relation exists without a RELATE operation.
Unknown and Insufficient are valid stored statuses.
Deletion is forbidden; withdrawal creates a new differentiating operation.
